easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Goblin Firestarter that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Repeat using the Goblin Firestarter token
